result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d remove the human tendency to dehumanize each other.

Not by making everyone agree, and not by erasing conflict, but by making it much harder for people to ignore the full reality of other people’s pain, fear, and humanity. Most cruelty, exploitation, and indifference seem to depend on the ability to treat certain people as less real, less complex, or less deserving than oneself. If that blind spot were gone, many other things would improve on their own.
